EDGESCAN_ASSET_TAG.description: Optional Edgescan asset tag to filter assets (forwarded as c[asset_tags]). Omit to pull every asset visible to the token.

EDGESCAN_MIN_SEVERITY.description: Minimum Faraday severity bucket to import. Valid values: info, low, medium, high, critical. Mapped to Edgescan's 1-5 scale (info=1, low=2, medium=3, high=4, critical=5) and forwarded as c[severity_gte]. Default: info.

name: edgescan
title: Edgescan
description: Edgescan vulnerability management importer. Pulls assets via /api/v1/assets (optionally filtered by tag) and per-asset findings via /api/v1/vulnerabilities; emits one Faraday host per Edgescan asset with severity bucketed from the Edgescan 1-5 scale (1=info, 2=low, 3=medium, 4=high, 5=critical). Auth is token-based — set EDGESCAN_TOKEN; EDGESCAN_HOST defaults to https://live.edgescan.com.
